description: A scenic vintage snapshot showing three individuals and a small dog standing on a stratified rocky riverbank beside turbulent rushing water and rapids. Dense evergreen trees line the opposite bank. The image features a decorative stylized border typical of 1920s to 1930s photo developing services and bears an original developer stamp from Arrow Photo Service in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
